tools.name: get_quality_settings
tools.description: Read QualitySettings (current level, level names, vSync, anti-aliasing).

tools.name: set_authoring_root
tools.description: Set the base folder (under Assets/) that bare authoring paths resolve against and are confined to. Use 'Assets' for full project access.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: Project-relative folder under Assets/, e.g. Assets/AgentWork. Use 'Assets' to allow the whole project.

tools.name: get_performance_stats
tools.description: Read render, memory, and frame-timing stats (structured, read-only).

tools.name: delete_asset
tools.description: Delete an asset from the project. Destructive: requires confirm=true.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Reference to the asset to delete (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Must be true to actually delete. Without it the command refuses (destructive guard).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, report the asset that would be deleted without deleting it.

tools.name: import_asset
tools.description: Import an external file (e.g. a texture, model, audio clip) into the project by copying it to a path under the authoring root, then importing it.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Absolute filesystem path to the external file to import.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Destination asset path relative to the authoring root, including extension. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the destination path.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be imported without writing anything.

tools.name: package_resolve
tools.description: Resolve/refresh packages from the manifest (re-fetch and re-link). May trigger a recompile/domain reload — poll recompile_status. Its outcome is recorded for package_status.

tools.name: set_player_settings
tools.description: Change PlayerSettings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z. Scripting backend / API level changes trigger a domain reload.

parameters.name: settings
parameters.description: Fields to change; omitted fields are left unchanged.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Apply the change. Without it the call is refused.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Preview the change without applying it.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Run a Unity Search query and return structured results.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Unity Search query string, e.g. 't:Material', 'p: my asset', 'h: Main Camera'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max results to return (capped 200).

tools.name: add_animator_parameter
tools.description: Add a parameter (Float | Int | Bool | Trigger) to an AnimatorController. A duplicate name returns code 'duplicate_parameter'.

parameters.name: controller
parameters.description: Reference to the AnimatorController to edit (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Parameter name.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Parameter type: Float | Int | Bool | Trigger.

parameters.name: defaultValue
parameters.description: Default value for Float/Int/Bool (ignored for Trigger).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs without writing the parameter.

tools.name: get_import_settings
tools.description: Read an asset's import settings, structured by importer type (texture/model/audio), including the default-platform fields and (for textures/audio) one platform override block.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Reference to the asset whose importer to read (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform whose override to read: Default | Standalone | iOS | Android | WebGL | tvOS. Defaults to Default.

tools.name: set_animation_curve
tools.description: Add or replace a single float curve binding on an AnimationClip (via AnimationUtility.SetEditorCurve). Replacing an existing binding overwrites it rather than duplicating.

parameters.name: clip
parameters.description: Reference to the AnimationClip to edit (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: GameObject path relative to the animated root the property lives on. Empty string (default) targets the root.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Component type the property lives on, e.g. "Transform", "UnityEngine.Light". Resolved via the component TypeResolver.

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: Curve property name, e.g. "m_LocalPosition.x", "m_LocalScale.y", "localEulerAnglesRaw.z".

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: Keyframes: [{ time, value, inTangent?, outTangent?, weightedMode?: "None"|"In"|"Out"|"Both" }]. Omitted tangents default to 0 (flat); this is NOT Unity's Auto tangent mode.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate type/property/keys without writing the curve.

tools.name: clear_occlusion_culling
tools.description: Clear baked occlusion-culling data for the open scene(s). Destructive: requires confirm=true.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Must be true to actually clear (destructive, not undoable via Unity's Undo).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, report what would be cleared without clearing.

tools.name: recompile_status
tools.description: Get the status of the last recompile: idle | triggered | compiling | completed | up_to_date.

tools.name: bake_navmesh
tools.description: Trigger an async legacy NavMesh bake of the open scene(s) via UnityEditor.AI.NavMeshBuilder. Returns immediately; poll navmesh_bake_status until completed.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Accepted for parity (a bake overwrites the existing NavMesh); not required.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate there is an open scene and return current NavMesh settings without baking.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Read a TimelineAsset's structure: frame rate, duration, and its tracks with their clips. Requires the com.unity.timeline package.

parameters.name: timeline
parameters.description: Reference to the TimelineAsset to read (path / guid / globalId).

tools.name: get_component_properties
tools.description: Get a component's serialized properties as a JSON map. Address the component by handle, or by GameObject handle + type.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Handle of the component, OR of the GameObject when 'type' is given.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Component type name on the target GameObject (omit when 'target' is a component handle).

tools.name: create_script
tools.description: Create a new C# script (default base class MonoBehaviour) from a template under the authoring root. NOTE: the type does not exist until a recompile completes — to attach it, call recompile, poll recompile_status, then attach_script.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Class/file name without extension, e.g. PlayerController. Must be a valid C# identifier.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Folder (relative to the authoring root; the Assets/ prefix is optional) to write the .cs into. Defaults to the authoring root.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Optional namespace to wrap the class in. Omit for the global namespace.

parameters.name: base_class
parameters.description: Base class to derive from. Defaults to MonoBehaviour.

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: Overwrite the file if it already exists. Defaults to false (an existing file is an error).

tools.name: editor_play
tools.description: Enter Unity Editor play mode

tools.name: delete_gameobject
tools.description: Delete a GameObject from the scene (reversible via Undo).

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Handle of the GameObject to delete.

tools.name: occlusion_bake_status
tools.description: Get the status of the last occlusion bake: idle | baking | completed.

tools.name: get_time_settings
tools.description: Read Time settings (fixedDeltaTime, maximumDeltaTime, timeScale).

tools.name: read_text_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file under the authoring root and return its contents.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Text file path relative to the authoring root. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: max_bytes
parameters.description: Reject files larger than this many bytes (default 1048576 = 1 MiB) to avoid huge payloads.

tools.name: cancel_tests
tools.description: Cancel running test execution

tools.name: clear_baked_lighting
tools.description: Clear baked lightmap data for the open scene(s). Destructive: requires confirm=true.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Must be true to actually clear (destructive, not undoable via Unity's Undo).

parameters.name: include_disk_cache
parameters.description: If true, also clear the GI disk cache (Lightmapping.ClearDiskCache()).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, report what would be cleared without clearing.

tools.name: editor_pause
tools.description: Pause Unity Editor play mode

tools.name: create_asset
tools.description: Create a new ScriptableObject (or other UnityEngine.Object) asset of the given type at a path under the authoring root.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Asset path relative to the authoring root, including extension (e.g. Data/Config.asset or Materials/Wall.mat). The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Fully-qualified or short type name to instantiate (e.g. UnityEngine.Material, MyGame.GameConfig). Must derive from UnityEngine.Object and be creatable.

parameters.name: shader
parameters.description: Material-only (ignored otherwise): shader name to assign (e.g. Standard, "Universal Render Pipeline/Lit"). When omitted, defaults to "Universal Render Pipeline/Lit" if a Scriptable Render Pipeline is active, otherwise the built-in "Standard" shader (falling back to "Standard" if URP/Lit is unavailable).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the path. Ignored when the path is empty.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be created without writing anything.

tools.name: create_gameobjects
tools.description: Batch-create N empty GameObjects or primitives in one call. Optional positions/rotations/scales are arrays of [x,y,z] (length must equal count). Returns the created identities.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Base name. With count>1 and no explicit names, objects are suffixed Name1..NameN.

parameters.name: primitive
parameters.description: Optional primitive type: cube, sphere, capsule, cylinder, plane, quad. Omit for empty GameObjects.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Optional parent handle. Every created object becomes a child of it.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: How many GameObjects to create. Default 1.

parameters.name: positions
parameters.description: Local positions, one [x,y,z] per object. Length must equal count when supplied.

parameters.name: rotations
parameters.description: Local Euler rotations (degrees), one [x,y,z] per object. Length must equal count when supplied.

parameters.name: scales
parameters.description: Local scales, one [x,y,z] per object. Length must equal count when supplied.

tools.name: get_authoring_root
tools.description: Get the base folder (under Assets/) that bare authoring paths resolve against.

tools.name: attach_script
tools.description: Add a MonoBehaviour to a GameObject by its (compiled) type name OR by its script asset path. Provide exactly one of 'type' or 'script'. If the type isn't compiled yet, returns a recoverable error: recompile, poll recompile_status, then retry.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Reference to the GameObject to add the component to (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Component type name to add, e.g. PlayerController or Game.Player.PlayerController. Must already be compiled. Mutually exclusive with 'script'.

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: Script asset path, e.g. 'Assets/Pool/Scripts/CueShooter.cs'. The backing class is resolved via MonoScript.GetClass(), so the class name may differ from the filename. Mutually exclusive with 'type'.

tools.name: cancel_lighting_bake
tools.description: Cancel an in-progress lighting bake (Lightmapping.Cancel()).

tools.name: create_scene
tools.description: Create a new scene and save it to the given path under the authoring root.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Scene path relative to the authoring root (default Assets/); the Assets/ prefix and the .unity extension are optional. e.g. Scenes/Level1

parameters.name: additive
parameters.description: Open the new scene additively alongside currently open scenes instead of replacing them.

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: Initial contents: 'empty' (default) for a blank scene, or 'default' to seed a Main Camera + Directional Light matching Unity's built-in 3D template.

tools.name: package_add
tools.description: Add a UPM package by name@version, git URL, or 'file:' local path. Async by default (returns in_progress; poll package_status); pass wait=true to block until added. A recompile/domain reload follows — poll recompile_status. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Package to add: 'com.unity.foo@1.2.3', a git URL, or 'file:../Path'.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Apply the change. Without it the call is refused.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Preview the change without applying it.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Block until the operation completes and return the result (synchronous). Default: return immediately and poll package_status.

tools.name: remove_animation_curve
tools.description: Remove a float curve binding from an AnimationClip (SetEditorCurve(clip, binding, null)). Destructive: requires confirm=true.

parameters.name: clip
parameters.description: Reference to the AnimationClip to edit (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: GameObject path relative to the animated root the binding lives on. Empty string (default) targets the root.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Component type of the binding to remove, e.g. "Transform". Resolved via the component TypeResolver.

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: Curve property name to remove, e.g. "m_LocalPosition.x".

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Must be true to actually remove the binding (destructive guard).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, report the binding that would be removed without removing it.

tools.name: set_parent
tools.description: Reparent a GameObject under a new parent, or detach it to scene root when no parent is given.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Handle of the GameObject to reparent.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Handle of the new parent. Omit (or empty) to move the object to the scene root.

parameters.name: world_position_stays
parameters.description: Keep the object's world position when reparenting. Default true.

tools.name: editor_stop
tools.description: Exit Unity Editor play mode

tools.name: package_remove
tools.description: Remove a UPM package by name. Async by default (returns in_progress; poll package_status); pass wait=true to block until removed. A recompile/domain reload follows — poll recompile_status. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Package name to remove (e.g. com.unity.foo).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Apply the change. Without it the call is refused.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Preview the change without applying it.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Block until the operation completes and return the result (synchronous). Default: return immediately and poll package_status.

tools.name: set_active
tools.description: Set a GameObject's active self-state (activeSelf).

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Handle of the GameObject.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Desired active state.

tools.name: create_timeline
tools.description: Create a .playable TimelineAsset under the authoring root (optional frame rate). Requires the com.unity.timeline package.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Asset path ending in .playable, relative to the authoring root. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: frameRate
parameters.description: Timeline frame rate (default 60).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the path.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be created without writing anything.

tools.name: list_open_scenes
tools.description: List all currently open scenes with their load/active/dirty state.

tools.name: bake_occlusion_culling
tools.description: Trigger an async occlusion-culling bake of the open scene(s) via StaticOcclusionCulling.GenerateInBackground(). Returns immediately; poll occlusion_bake_status until completed.

parameters.name: smallest_occluder
parameters.description: Smallest object that will occlude others (meters). Defaults to Unity's current value.

parameters.name: smallest_hole
parameters.description: Smallest gap geometry can have that the view can see through (meters). Defaults to Unity's current value.

parameters.name: backface_threshold
parameters.description: Backface threshold (1-100); lower trims more backfaces. Defaults to Unity's current value.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Accepted for parity (a bake overwrites existing occlusion data); not required.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate there is an open scene and report the parameters that would be used without baking.

tools.name: get_player_settings
tools.description: Read PlayerSettings (company/product/version, scripting backend, API level).

tools.name: get_navmesh_settings
tools.description: Read the default agent's legacy NavMesh bake settings (agentRadius/Height/Slope/Climb, minRegionArea, voxelSize).

tools.name: unpack_prefab
tools.description: Unpack a prefab instance into plain GameObjects (outermost level or completely).

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: Reference to a prefab instance GameObject in a scene (instanceId/hierarchyPath/globalId).

parameters.name: completely
parameters.description: If true, unpack all nested prefab levels (Completely); if false, only the outermost level (OutermostRoot).

tools.name: save_prefab_contents
tools.description: Open a prefab asset in an isolated prefab stage, apply a declarative edit, and save it back (nested-prefab safe).

parameters.name: prefab
parameters.description: Reference to the prefab asset to edit (path/guid/globalId).

parameters.name: rename_child
parameters.description: Optional child name (relative path under the root, e.g. 'Body/Head') to rename.

parameters.name: new_name
parameters.description: New name for the child identified by rename_child.

parameters.name: set_active_child
parameters.description: Optional child name (relative path under the root) whose active state to set.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Active state to apply when set_active_child is provided.

tools.name: recompile
tools.description: Force a script recompile (works while unfocused/minimized). Poll recompile_status for completion.

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: If true, bring the Editor to the foreground before compiling. Off by default.

tools.name: build_status
tools.description: Status of the current/most recent build: idle | queued | building | completed, with the full BuildReport (files, packedAssets, buildSteps, errors, warnings) once completed. Retained until the next build.

tools.name: get_material_properties
tools.description: Read a material's shader, render queue, enabled keywords, and all shader properties with their current values (Color as [r,g,b,a], Vector as [x,y,z,w], Texture as an object reference).

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Reference to the .mat asset (or a loaded material) to read (path / guid / globalId / instanceId).

tools.name: set_material_properties
tools.description: Set shader properties on a material (Float/Range/Int=number; Color=[r,g,b,a] or "#RRGGBBAA" hex; Vector=[x,y,z,w]; Texture=an object reference or null to clear), optionally reassign the shader, set the render queue, and toggle keywords. Unknown names / type mismatches are reported in unknown[].

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Reference to the .mat asset (or a loaded material) to edit (path / guid / globalId / instanceId).

parameters.name: shader
parameters.description: Reassign the material's shader by name (e.g. "Standard", "Universal Render Pipeline/Lit", or a Shader Graph shader name). Applied before properties so new property names resolve against the new shader.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: JSON object of shader property name -> value. Names must include the leading underscore (e.g. _BaseColor). Float/Range/Int=number; Color=[r,g,b,a] or hex string; Vector=[x,y,z,w]; Texture=an object reference {guid/path} or null.

parameters.name: renderQueue
parameters.description: Explicit render queue, or -1 to inherit from the shader. Omit to leave unchanged.

parameters.name: enableKeywords
parameters.description: Shader keywords to enable (e.g. _NORMALMAP, _EMISSION).

parameters.name: disableKeywords
parameters.description: Shader keywords to disable.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Reserved for parity; editing an existing material is non-destructive and undoable, so it is not required.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate the shader, resolve property names and texture refs, and report applied[]/unknown[] without writing anything.

tools.name: switch_build_target
tools.description: Switch the active build target (destructive, long-running: triggers a full reimport + domain reload). Requires confirm=true. Returns immediately; poll switch_build_target_status.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: BuildTarget name to switch to (must be installed; see list_build_targets).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Apply the switch. Without it the call is refused.

tools.name: list_build_targets
tools.description: List the known BuildTarget values with their group and whether build support is installed.

tools.name: bake_navmesh_surfaces
tools.description: Bake NavMeshSurface components (AI Navigation package). v1 stub: returns package_not_found when the package is absent.

tools.name: rename_asset
tools.description: Rename an asset in place (keeps it in the same folder, keeps its GUID).

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Reference to the asset to rename (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: new_name
parameters.description: New file name WITHOUT a folder path. The extension is preserved if omitted.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate the rename without performing it.

tools.name: get_animator_controller
tools.description: Read an AnimatorController's full structure: parameters, layers, states (with motion / default), and transitions (with conditions).

parameters.name: controller
parameters.description: Reference to the AnimatorController to read (path / guid / globalId).

tools.name: editor_focus
tools.description: Bring the Unity Editor window to the foreground

tools.name: get_lighting_settings
tools.description: Read the active LightingSettings (lightmapper, bounces, resolution, directional mode, AO, etc.).

tools.name: set_lighting_settings
tools.description: Apply a subset of lighting settings to the active LightingSettings. Returns { applied[], unknown[] }.

parameters.name: settings
parameters.description: JSON object with a subset of lighting fields to set (same names/enums as get_lighting_settings).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate the keys and report applied/unknown without changing anything.

tools.name: revert_prefab_overrides
tools.description: Revert a prefab instance's overrides so it matches its source prefab asset.

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: Reference to a prefab instance GameObject in a scene (instanceId/hierarchyPath/globalId).

tools.name: add_component
tools.description: Add a component (by type name) to a GameObject.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Handle of the GameObject.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Component type name (e.g. 'Rigidbody' or 'UnityEngine.Camera').

tools.name: test_status
tools.description: Get status of running async test execution

tools.name: set_autotick
tools.description: Keep the editor ticking while unfocused by forcing EditorApplication.SignalTick at a throttled rate

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: Enable (true) or disable (false) auto-tick mode

parameters.name: interval_ms
parameters.description: Minimum milliseconds between forced ticks. 0 = every update (max rate, pegs a CPU core). Default 16 (~60Hz).

tools.name: build
tools.description: Trigger an async Player build and report the full BuildReport. Returns immediately (queued); poll build_status until status is 'completed'. DetailedBuildReport is included by default unless 'options' is supplied. Use dry_run to validate without building.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: BuildTarget name (e.g. StandaloneWindows64). Defaults to the active target. Must be installed.

parameters.name: outputPath
parameters.description: Output path (absolute, or relative to the project root). Defaults to the last/auto path.

parameters.name: profileName
parameters.description: Build Profile name to activate before building (Unity 6 only; ignored otherwise).

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: BuildOptions names. Omit to get just DetailedBuildReport; supplying any disables that default.

parameters.name: scenes
parameters.description: Scene asset paths to build (e.g. Assets/Scenes/Main.unity). Defaults to EditorBuildSettings.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Acknowledge and run the build; without it the call is refused. Use dry_run to validate only.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Validate target/outputPath/scenes without building.

tools.name: get_console_logs
tools.description: Read recently captured Editor console logs (structured).

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Filter: all | log | warning | error. 'all' = every entry; 'log' = Log only; 'warning' = Warning only; 'error' = Error/Exception/Assert only.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max entries to return (most-recent first), capped at 1000.

tools.name: write_text_file
tools.description: Write UTF-8 text to a file under the authoring root, then import it. Overwriting an existing file requires confirm=true.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Text file path relative to the authoring root, including extension. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: contents
parameters.description: The full text content to write (replaces the file).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing file at the path.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be written without writing anything.

tools.name: lighting_bake_status
tools.description: Get the status of the last lighting bake: idle | baking | completed.

tools.name: create_animation_clip
tools.description: Create an empty .anim AnimationClip asset under the authoring root, with an optional frame rate and loop flag.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Asset path ending in .anim, relative to the authoring root. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: frameRate
parameters.description: Sampling frame rate of the clip (default 60).

parameters.name: loop
parameters.description: If true, set the clip's loop-time flag in its AnimationClipSettings (default false).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the path.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be created without writing anything.

tools.name: instantiate_prefab
tools.description: Instantiate a prefab asset into a loaded scene and return the created instance.

parameters.name: prefab
parameters.description: Reference to the prefab asset to instantiate (path/guid/globalId).

parameters.name: scene_path
parameters.description: Optional path of a loaded scene to instantiate into; defaults to the active scene.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Optional name for the created instance; defaults to the prefab name.

tools.name: get_physics_settings
tools.description: Read Physics settings (gravity, solver iterations, bounce threshold).

tools.name: set_transform
tools.description: Set a GameObject's local position/rotation(euler)/scale. Omitted channels are left unchanged.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Handle of the GameObject to modify.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Local position as [x,y,z].

parameters.name: rotation
parameters.description: Local rotation as Euler angles [x,y,z] in degrees.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Local scale as [x,y,z].

tools.name: list_shaders
tools.description: Discover available shaders so an agent can pick a valid name for set_material_properties / create_asset. Returns [{ name, assetPath|null, isBuiltin, isSupported }].

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the shader name (e.g. "URP", "Lit").

parameters.name: includeBuiltin
parameters.description: Include built-in/engine shaders (those with no project asset path). Default true.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of shaders to return (default 200).

tools.name: clear_console
tools.description: Clear the captured log buffer and the Unity Editor console.

tools.name: capture_scene_view
tools.description: Render the active Scene View to a PNG. Returns it inline as base64, unless save_path is set (path-only result; pass include_inline_image=true to get both).

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output width in px (default 1280; capped 4096).

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Output height in px (default 720; capped 4096).

parameters.name: save_path
parameters.description: Optional project-relative path to write the PNG (e.g. Screenshots/foo.png). When set, the result omits the inline base64 image unless include_inline_image=true.

parameters.name: include_inline_image
parameters.description: Also return the image inline as base64 when save_path is set (default false: path-only result). Only meaningful together with save_path.

parameters.name: max_resolution
parameters.description: Cap on the inline image's longest edge (e.g. 512). Only applies when an inline image is returned (no save_path, or save_path + include_inline_image=true); the save_path file keeps the requested resolution.

tools.name: set_selection
